# planetscale_neki_admin (Data Source)

NekiAdmin DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_admin" "my_nekiadmin" {
  branch       = "...my_branch..."
  database     = "...my_database..."
  organization = "...my_organization..."
  parameters = {
    key = {
      # ...
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch name from `list_branches`. Example: `main`.
- `database` (String) Database name slug from `list_databases`. Example: `app-db`.
- `organization` (String) Organization name slug from `list_organizations`. Example: `acme`.

### Optional

- `parameters` (Map of Map of String) Managed effective admin parameter values nested by namespace. Remote non-default values are adopted during reads.

### Read-Only

- `admin_size` (String) The admin size SKU name
- `id` (String) The ID of the admin
- `state` (String) The current state of the admin
